description: Test suite for the LinkMetadata store in Mattermost, including save, get, type handling, and hash collision tests.

methods.name: getNextLinkMetadataTimestamp
methods.description: Generates the next unique timestamp for link metadata entries.

methods.name: testLinkMetadataStoreSave
methods.description: Tests saving link metadata, including valid, invalid, duplicate URL/timestamp, and data updates.

methods.name: testLinkMetadataStoreGet
methods.description: Tests retrieving link metadata by URL and timestamp, including not found scenarios.

methods.name: testLinkMetadataStoreTypes
methods.description: Tests saving and retrieving different data types like image metadata and opengraph data.

methods.name: testLinkMetadataStoreHashCollisionHandling
methods.description: Tests handling of hash collisions for different URLs with the same hash.
